assembly.source_rendering_notes: Complete editable native arXivv3 completeness development, including all ten mathematical appendices rather than condensed conference transfer tables. Original circuit PDFs keep figures/... paths and native tikzfig macro. Adjacent minimality section preserves native labels/context and is not another target. Standard theorem environments and class-provided subcaption/threeparttable equivalents are supplied mechanically. Native macros are unchanged; inactive commented proof alternatives and unused macros are not interpreted as missing core figures. Every active directly referenced circuit PDF exists. Native tabularx-debride.sty retains LPPL notice and is accompanied by the complete official CTAN Tools Bundle per its header. Native bibliography is root-compiled; no proof assistant or own compilation is run. Native LIPIcs-only nolinenumbers switch is omitted in the standalone article class. Fourteen equivalent asset specs using figures/./... and figures/... are deduplicated by normalized source/target paths; all body references and original PDFs remain unchanged. There are1038 independent circuit PDF assets representing1052 named references, not deleted diagrams. Native appendix_others.tex actually uses threeparttable and tablenotes at lines428/473. Original CTAN threeparttable.sty by Donald Arseneau is bundled unchanged with its permissive notice and complete CTAN archive; no global installation or mathematical macro replacement. Original proof.sty and its GPL1-or-later notice/license text are reused from this lane previously compiled material, without macro replacement or global installation. The unused subfiles wrapper import is omitted after all selected body spans and bundled style files were checked to contain no subfile/subfix/helper calls; mathematical source and diagrams remain unchanged. The actual native source includes plainurl.bst (urlbst0.9.1), now declared as a local build asset with its unchanged LPPL and original BibTeX permission headers; no replacement bibliography style is introduced. Official CTAN urlbst0.9.1 archive including README licensing discussion and LICENCE-lppl.txt is bundled with the unchanged native plainurl.bst.
